audit.whatIsWrong: The entry's central instruction is 'commit your level-6 all-in before Sylas learns to hold R' and it never gives the Hijack cooldown, which is the number the whole plan turns on.
audit.why: Hijack is 80/55/30. At rank 1 an eighty-second window is a real one — you get roughly one Between Worlds per two of his Hijacks early. By rank 3 it is 30 seconds and the window is gone. That is a concrete timeline the reader can act on; 'before he learns' is not.
audit.corrected: Hijack's 80/55/30 written into the level-6 spike and the cooldown breakdown, and Abscond/Abduct's 13s given for the dodge.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three strings sell Between Worlds as an 'untargetable rift'. It is not, and the error compounds here: the entry then warns that Sylas hijacks your untargetable rift, so the reader is being told to fear a stolen ability that does not do what they were told it does.
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/aurora.json: Between Worlds leaps, releases a slowing shockwave, and creates a zone she can teleport across. No untargetability. Across the Veil grants invisibility. Kingslayer heals him and Abscond/Abduct is a dash plus a recast pull on 13s — those are the real interactions.
audit.corrected: Untargetability removed from spikes[1], spikes[2], mid and late; the rift restated as the slow-plus-teleport it is, which is still worth stealing and still the reason not to press it into an up Hijack.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Abscond/Abduct as matchup-defining with no number and never mentions Hijack, which is the cooldown the entry's own win condition depends on.
The entry repeatedly says his Q/W lifesteal out-sustains you and never once names the item answer or its timing.
audit.why: _missing flags needs-antiheal on Kingslayer, and the kit confirms heal on W. The drain-tank scaling the late paragraph warns about is exactly what Grievous Wounds is for, and it needs to be in the first-item slot, not the third.

notes:
'Untargetable rift' appears three more times here (spikes[1], spikes[2], mid, late). Aurora has no untargetability in her kit at all. This matchup is where the error does the most damage, because the entry builds a second warning on top of the first — 'he hijacks your untargetable rift' — so the reader now believes two false things that reinforce each other.

The fix that adds the most: the entry's whole win condition is 'all-in at 6 BEFORE he learns to hold R', which is unactionable. Hijack is 80/55/30. At rank 1 the window is eighty seconds wide and genuinely exploitable; at rank 3 it is thirty and effectively gone. That turns a vibe into a timeline.

The suspectName 'Your Between Worlds' at spikes[1] was a FALSE POSITIVE — the detector matched the possessive against the bare ability name. Between Worlds is correct there.

The chart gave four stages to Skill and level 6 to Sylas, when whys[4] says in capital letters that level 6 is Aurora's. Fixed as an atomic group.

Deliberately not asserted: what Sylas actually receives when he hijacks Between Worlds — whether he gets the two-way teleport across the zone or only the leap and shockwave. That materially changes how afraid the reader should be, and neither aurora.json nor sylas.json answers it. QUESTION FOR YOU: if you can confirm the hijacked version's behaviour, spikes[2] and the late paragraph should both be rewritten around it.
